nodal_ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
implementing_agency: Khadi and Village Industries Commission (KVIC) / DIC
summary: Credit-linked subsidy programme to generate self-employment opportunities through establishment of micro-enterprises in manufacturing and service sectors.
eligibility_criteria_text: Any individual above 18 years of age.
At least VIII standard pass for projects costing above Rs.10 lakh in manufacturing and above Rs.5 lakh in service sector.
Only new projects are eligible; existing units or units that have availed government subsidy under other schemes are not eligible.
Self Help Groups (SHGs), Institutions registered under Societies Registration Act 1860, Production Co-operative Societies, and Charitable Trusts are also eligible.

benefits.quantum_description: 15% to 35% margin money subsidy. Max project cost: ₹50 Lakh for manufacturing, ₹20 Lakh for services. Beneficiary contribution is 5% to 10%.

required_documents: Rural Area Certificate (issued by Gram Panchayat/Patwari for rural classification)
application_mode: Online via KVIC PMEGP Portal / Jan Samarth
application_process: Step 1: Visit the official PMEGP e-Portal (kviconline.gov.in) or Jan Samarth platform.
Step 2: Click 'Apply Online' for New Enterprise or 2nd Loan for Upgradation.
Step 3: Enter Aadhaar number, PAN, applicant personal details, and social category.
Step 4: Select Sponsoring Agency (KVIC, KVIB, or District Industries Centre - DIC).
Step 5: Select Financing Bank Branch where loan is sought.
Step 6: Upload Detailed Project Report (DPR), educational certificate (Class 8th pass), caste certificate, and rural area certificate.
Step 7: Submit application to generate Unique Application ID and download acknowledgement slip.
Step 8: Undergo DIC/KVIC task force scrutiny followed by electronic forwarding to the selected bank branch.
Step 9: Bank conducts sanction and physical unit verification; complete mandatory EDP training to receive margin money subsidy in escrow.
application_process_md:
### How to Apply for PMEGP

1. **Online Application:** Visit [KVIC PMEGP Portal](https://www.kviconline.gov.in/pmegpeportal/pmegphome/index.jsp).
2. **Applicant Details:** Enter Aadhaar and demographic details.
3. **Agency Selection:** Choose DIC / KVIC / KVIB based on location.
4. **Upload Documentation:** Attach Detailed Project Report, marksheet, and category certificates.
5. **Sanction & Subsidy:** Bank sanctions composite credit facility; 15% to 35% margin money subsidy is locked for 3 years.

scheme_name: Credit Guarantee Scheme for Micro & Small Enterprises
nodal_ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
implementing_agency: Credit Guarantee Fund Trust for Micro and Small Enterprises (CGTMSE) / Member Lending Institutions (MLIs)
summary: Facilitates collateral-free credit facilities (term loans and working capital) up to ₹5 Crore from commercial banks and financial institutions for micro and small enterprises.
eligibility_criteria_text: Both new and existing Micro and Small Enterprises (MSEs) engaged in manufacturing or service activities.
Retail trade and wholesale trade are also covered up to eligible limits.
Borrower unit must hold valid Udyam Registration and GST Registration.
Facility covers loans up to ₹500 Lakh without third-party guarantee or collateral security.

benefits.quantum_description: Collateral-free credit up to ₹5 Crore with guarantee coverage of 75% to 85% (up to 85% for women entrepreneurs, SC/ST, and units in NER/Aspirational districts).

required_documents: ITR & Audited Balance Sheets for existing units (last 2-3 years)
application_mode: Through Member Lending Institutions (MLIs) / Jan Samarth
application_process: Step 1: Formulate comprehensive business plan and project report with fund requirement up to ₹5 Crore.
Step 2: Approach any CGTMSE Member Lending Institution (Scheduled Commercial Bank, SIDBI, RRB, or NBFC).
Step 3: Apply for collateral-free MSME credit facility (term loan and/or working capital).
Step 4: Bank conducts appraisal and issues in-principle sanction without requiring collateral or third-party guarantee.
Step 5: Lending bank submits borrower profile directly to CGTMSE digital portal for guarantee coverage.
Step 6: CGTMSE issues digital guarantee cover (up to 85% for women/Micro units, 75% for others) upon payment of upfront guarantee fee.
Step 7: Loan disbursement into borrower's operative account.
application_process_md:
### How to Apply for CGTMSE Guarantee

1. **Direct Bank Approach:** Apply at any Scheduled Commercial Bank or through [Jan Samarth](https://www.jansamarth.in).
2. **Collateral-Free Assessment:** Lending institution evaluates business viability under CGTMSE trust guidelines.
3. **Guarantee Issuance:** MLI enrolls account on CGTMSE portal; credit guarantee certificate issued digitally.

nodal_ministry: Ministry of Finance - Department of Financial Services
implementing_agency: MUDRA / Commercial Banks, RRBs, Small Finance Banks, MFIs
summary: Micro-finance credit facility providing loans up to ₹50,000 for early-stage or very small micro-enterprises with minimal paperwork and zero collateral.
eligibility_criteria_text: Any Indian citizen who has a business plan for non-farm income-generating activity such as manufacturing, processing, trading, or service sector.
Loan requirement is up to ₹50,000.
No collateral required.
Applicant must not be a defaulter to any bank or financial institution.

benefits.quantum_description: Loans up to ₹50,000 at competitive bank interest rates, nil processing fee, and zero collateral security.

required_documents: Identity Proof (Voter ID / Aadhaar / PAN / Driving License)
Quotation of machinery/items to be purchased or business outline
application_mode: Online via Jan Samarth / Bank Branch
application_process: Step 1: Visit Jan Samarth portal (jansamarth.in) or visit nearest bank / MFI branch.
Step 2: Complete basic registration with mobile number, Aadhaar, and business profile.
Step 3: Select 'Business Activity Loan' -> 'MUDRA Shishu' category (up to ₹50,000).
Step 4: Enter quotation of machinery/inventory to be purchased and supplier details.
Step 5: Upload identity proof (Aadhaar/Voter ID), address proof, and applicant photograph.
Step 6: Jan Samarth issues instant digital in-principle approval and routes application to chosen bank.
Step 7: Bank verifies documents, executes loan agreement (zero processing fee, zero collateral), and disburses loan with MUDRA debit card.
application_process_md:
### How to Apply for PMMY Shishu Loan (up to ₹50,000)

1. **Jan Samarth Portal:** Register on [Jan Samarth](https://www.jansamarth.in).
2. **Simple Form:** Provide quotation of tools/machinery or inventory.
3. **Instant Approval:** In-principle digital sanction routed to preferred bank branch.

nodal_ministry: Ministry of Finance - Department of Financial Services
implementing_agency: MUDRA / Scheduled Commercial Banks, RRBs, NBFCs
summary: Mid-tier micro credit providing business loans from ₹50,000 to ₹5,00,000 for expanding micro business enterprises.
eligibility_criteria_text: Micro-enterprises that have already commenced operations and need funds between ₹50,000 and ₹5,00,000 for business expansion or machinery acquisition.
Clean credit history and non-defaulter status.
Valid business registration or establishment proof (GST / Shop & Est / Udyam).

benefits.quantum_description: Term loan or working capital overdraft from ₹50,000 to ₹5,00,000 without collateral.

required_documents: Last 1-2 years Sales Tax / GST Returns or Financial accounts
application_mode: Online via Jan Samarth / Bank Portals
application_process: Step 1: Access Jan Samarth portal or partner bank MSME loan portal.
Step 2: Register and select 'MUDRA Kishore' category (loan amount ₹50,000 to ₹5 Lakh).
Step 3: Submit KYC documents (Aadhaar, PAN), business address proof, and Udyam Registration.
Step 4: Provide last 6 to 12 months bank statements, sales turnover details, and machinery/equipment quotation.
Step 5: Select preferred lending bank branch and submit digital application.
Step 6: Receive digital in-principle sanction letter.
Step 7: Bank conducts credit appraisal, opens loan account, and disburses credit without collateral.
application_process_md:
### How to Apply for PMMY Kishore Loan (₹50,000 to ₹5 Lakh)

1. **Digital Application:** Apply via [Jan Samarth](https://www.jansamarth.in).
2. **Financials & Quotations:** Provide 6-month bank statements and machinery purchase invoices.
3. **Branch Sanction:** Bank issues credit sanction without collateral.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana - Tarun & Tarun Plus
nodal_ministry: Ministry of Finance - Department of Financial Services
summary: Flagship credit facility offering loans from ₹5 Lakh up to ₹20 Lakh (Tarun Plus) for scaling mature micro businesses.
eligibility_criteria_text: Established micro and small business units requiring higher capital for scaling.
Loan requirement between ₹5,00,000 and ₹10,00,000 (and up to ₹20 Lakh under Tarun Plus for previous borrowers who successfully repaid Tarun loans).
Documented operating history of at least 1-2 years with positive cash flows.

benefits.quantum_description: Credit facility from ₹5 Lakh up to ₹20 Lakh without collateral requirement.

required_documents: Audited Balance Sheet and P&L for last 2 years
ITR Returns (last 2 years) along with computation of income
application_mode: Online via Jan Samarth / Bank Digital Lending Portals
application_process: Step 1: Register on Jan Samarth portal or partner bank MSME lending website.
Step 2: Select 'MUDRA Tarun' (₹5 Lakh to ₹10 Lakh) or 'Tarun Plus' (up to ₹20 Lakh for successful past borrowers).
Step 3: Provide Udyam Registration Certificate, GSTIN, and past 1-2 years audited financial statements / ITR.
Step 4: Upload Detailed Project Report (DPR) detailing expansion, machinery requirements, and projected cash flows.
Step 5: Select lending institution and generate digital in-principle sanction.
Step 6: Bank branch conducts loan evaluation and technical-economic feasibility check.
Step 7: Sanction and disbursement of term loan and working capital limit under collateral-free guarantee.
application_process_md:
### How to Apply for PMMY Tarun Loan (₹5 Lakh to ₹20 Lakh)

1. **Portal Application:** Register on [Jan Samarth](https://www.jansamarth.in).
2. **Enterprise Due Diligence:** Upload Udyam, GST returns, and audited balance sheets.
3. **Disbursement:** Bank sanctions facility under MUDRA credit guarantee.

nodal_ministry: Ministry of Finance - Department of Financial Services
summary: Bank loans between ₹10 Lakh and ₹1 Crore to at least one Scheduled Caste (SC) or Scheduled Tribe (ST) borrower and at least one woman borrower per bank branch for setting up greenfield enterprises.
eligibility_criteria_text: SC/ST and/or woman entrepreneurs above 18 years of age.
Loans under the scheme are available only for greenfield projects (the first-time venture of the beneficiary in manufacturing, services, agri-allied activities, or trading).
In case of non-individual enterprises, 51% of the shareholding and controlling stake must be held by either SC/ST and/or women entrepreneur.
Borrower should not be in default to any bank or financial institution.

benefits.quantum_description: Composite loan (term loan and working capital) between ₹10 Lakh and ₹1 Crore covering up to 85% of total project cost.

required_documents: Identity and Address Proof of applicant/promoters
Proof of Woman Ownership (CA Certificate or ROC Shareholding pattern showing ≥ 51% equity)
Lease deed / land allotment papers for business premises
application_mode: Online via Stand-Up Mitra Portal / Jan Samarth
application_process: Step 1: Visit the official Stand-Up Mitra portal (standupmitra.in).
Step 2: Click 'Register' as a borrower and complete the eligibility profile check (SC, ST, or Woman entrepreneur with >= 51% shareholding).
Step 3: Choose whether applying as 'Ready Borrower' (project report ready) or 'Trainee Borrower' (needing handholding support).
Step 4: Fill in enterprise details: greenfield project in manufacturing, services, or trading sector (cost ₹10 Lakh to ₹1 Crore).
Step 5: Upload KYC, Caste Certificate (for SC/ST), Udyam Registration, project report, and promoter margin proof (minimum 10-15%).
Step 6: Select preferred bank branch from network of over 1.4 lakh bank branches nationwide.
Step 7: Bank reviews application, sanctions composite loan (term loan + working capital), and provides credit guarantee coverage under NCGTC.
application_process_md:
### How to Apply for Stand-Up India (₹10 Lakh to ₹1 Crore)

1. **Registration:** Sign up on [Stand-Up Mitra](https://www.standupmitra.in).
2. **Eligibility Audit:** Verify SC, ST, or Woman ownership criteria.
3. **Submission:** Upload Detailed Project Report and select preferred lending bank branch.

nodal_ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
summary: End-to-end holistic support for traditional artisans and craftspeople across 18 designated trades, including skill training, ₹15,000 toolkit incentive, and collateral-free credit at 5% interest.
eligibility_criteria_text: An artisan or craftsperson working with hands and tools, engaged in one of 18 family-based traditional trades.
Minimum age of 18 years on the date of registration.
The beneficiary should not have availed loans under similar credit-based schemes of Central or State Government (e.g. PMEGP, PM SVANidhi, Mudra) in the past 5 years.
Registration is restricted to one member of the family.

benefits.quantum_description: PM Vishwakarma Certificate & ID card, ₹15,000 toolkit incentive e-voucher, basic & advanced training with ₹500/day stipend, and collateral-free credit support up to ₹3 Lakh (₹1 Lakh tranche-1 and ₹2 Lakh tranche-2) at concessional interest rate of 5%.

application_mode: Online via Common Services Centre (CSC) / PM Vishwakarma Portal
application_process: Step 1: Artisan or craftsperson visits nearest Common Services Centre (CSC) with Aadhaar and Aadhaar-linked mobile number.
Step 2: Complete biometric authentication and registration on the PM Vishwakarma Portal (pmvishwakarma.gov.in).
Step 3: Select recognized traditional trade (e.g. carpenter, blacksmith, potter, tailor, cobbler, mason, etc.).
Step 4: Level 1 verification: Scrutiny by Gram Panchayat / Urban Local Body (ULB) chairman.
Step 5: Level 2 verification: District Implementation Committee screening and approval.
Step 6: Level 3 verification: National Steering Committee approval and issuance of PM Vishwakarma Certificate & Digital ID Card.
Step 7: Undergo 5-7 days basic skill training with ₹500/day stipend.
Step 8: Receive ₹15,000 digital toolkit e-voucher/incentive.
Step 9: Apply for collateral-free enterprise loan: Tranche 1 up to ₹1 Lakh (at concessional 5% interest), and Tranche 2 up to ₹2 Lakh upon timely repayment.
application_process_md:
### How to Apply for PM Vishwakarma Scheme

1. **CSC Biometric Enrollment:** Visit nearest CSC center to register on [PM Vishwakarma](https://pmvishwakarma.gov.in).
2. **Three-Tier Verification:** Gram Panchayat -> District Committee -> National Committee.
3. **Training & Toolkit:** Receive ₹15,000 toolkit voucher and access to 5% interest loan.

scheme_name: Credit Linked Capital Subsidy Scheme (MSME Champions Scheme)
nodal_ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
implementing_agency: Office of Development Commissioner (MSME) / SIDBI / NABARD
summary: 15% upfront capital subsidy for micro and small enterprises to modernize plant, equipment, and machinery with state-of-the-art technology in 51 approved sub-sectors.
eligibility_criteria_text: Registered Micro and Small Enterprises having valid Udyam Registration.
Must be upgrading existing plant and machinery or establishing new facility with proven technology in approved sub-sectors.
Loan availed from scheduled commercial banks, state financial corporations, or SIDBI/NABARD.
Replacement of obsolete technology with modern energy-efficient machinery.

benefits.quantum_description: 15% upfront capital subsidy on institutional term loan availed for purchase of eligible machinery, calculated on loan up to ₹1 Crore (Maximum subsidy ₹15 Lakh).

required_documents: Sanction Letter of institutional term loan from Bank
Machinery Invoices / Technical Specifications & Manufacturer details
Audited accounts / CA Certificate for investment in plant & machinery
application_mode: Online via MSME Champions Single Window Portal
application_process: Step 1: Enterprise identifies eligible well-established technology / machinery from approved MSME technology list.
Step 2: Apply for term loan for technology upgradation through designated Primary Lending Institution (PLI / Bank).
Step 3: Lending institution sanctions and disburses loan for machinery acquisition.
Step 4: Bank uploads subsidy application claim on MSME Champions / CLCSS online tracking system.
Step 5: Nodal agency (SIDBI / NABARD) inspects compliance and forwards claim to Ministry of MSME.
Step 6: Ministry approves 15% upfront capital subsidy (capped at ₹15 Lakh on max ₹1 Crore project cost).
Step 7: Subsidy funds credited to borrower account and held as term deposit with 3-year lock-in period.
application_process_md:
### How to Apply for CLCSS Technology Subsidy

1. **Machinery Term Loan:** Avail term loan from commercial bank for approved machinery.
2. **Bank Claim Upload:** Primary lending bank files subsidy claim on [MSME Champions](https://champions.gov.in).
3. **Disbursement:** 15% capital subsidy credited to term deposit account.

scheme_name: PM Formalisation of Micro food processing Enterprises Scheme
nodal_ministry: Ministry of Food Processing Industries
summary: Credit-linked financial assistance, technical support, and business upgrade for individual and collective micro food processing units under the One District One Product (ODOP) framework.
eligibility_criteria_text: Existing micro food processing enterprise or new unit aligning with ODOP (One District One Product).
Enterprise must have ownership right/long-term lease over premises.
Applicant should be above 18 years of age with basic literacy.
Beneficiary must contribute at least 10% of the project cost as equity.

benefits.quantum_description: 35% credit-linked capital subsidy on eligible project cost, with maximum ceiling of ₹10 Lakh per unit.

required_documents: Udyam / GST Registration / FSSAI Food License
Detailed Project Report (DPR) of food processing unit
Bank Account details & quotation of food processing equipment
application_mode: Online Portal via MOFPI PMFME Portal
application_process: Step 1: Visit the official PMFME portal (pmfme.mofpi.gov.in) and register as individual enterprise or group (SHG/FPO/Cooperative).
Step 2: Select the designated 'One District One Product' (ODOP) food processing trade or non-ODOP existing processing unit.
Step 3: Connect with District Resource Person (DRP) assigned by State Nodal Agency for handholding and DPR preparation.
Step 4: Complete online application form detailing proposed machinery, processing capacity, and project cost up to ₹30 Lakh.
Step 5: Upload Udyam Certificate, FSSAI registration/license, KYC, bank statements, and Detailed Project Report (DPR).
Step 6: District Level Committee (DLC) screens application and recommends it to selected lending bank.
Step 7: Bank sanctions credit-linked term loan; 35% capital subsidy (up to ₹10 Lakh) is credited into borrower subsidy reserve fund.
application_process_md:
### How to Apply for PMFME Food Processing Subsidy

1. **Online Portal:** Register on [PMFME MOFPI](https://pmfme.mofpi.gov.in).
2. **DRP Handholding:** Work with District Resource Person for DPR formulation.
3. **Credit Linked Subsidy:** Bank disburses loan with 35% capital subsidy up to ₹10 Lakh.

nodal_ministry: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare
implementing_agency: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare / NABARD / Commercial Banks
summary: Medium-long term debt financing facility for investment in viable projects for post-harvest management infrastructure and community farming assets.
eligibility_criteria_text: Agri-entrepreneurs, Startups, Primary Agricultural Credit Societies (PACS), FPOs, SHGs, and MSMEs setting up post-harvest management facilities.
Eligible projects include cold chains, pack houses, silos, sorting/grading units, assaying units, and ripening chambers.
Borrower must have credit approval from participating lending institutions.

benefits.quantum_description: 3% interest subvention per annum on institutional loans up to ₹2 Crore for a maximum duration of 7 years, along with CGTMSE credit guarantee coverage fee paid by Government.

required_documents: Detailed Project Report (DPR) with civil and technical estimates
Land ownership title or registered long lease (minimum 10 years)
Statutory approvals / clearances for civil construction
application_mode: Online Portal via AIF Portal
application_process: Step 1: Access the Agriculture Infrastructure Fund portal (agriinfra.dac.gov.in) and register as a borrower.
Step 2: Choose project category (post-harvest management infrastructure, cold chain, sorting/grading, primary processing, or e-marketing platform).
Step 3: Upload Detailed Project Report (DPR), land title / lease documents, Udyam/GSTIN, and promoter background.
Step 4: Submit application online; initial scrutiny is conducted by Project Management Unit (PMU) within 7 working days.
Step 5: Application routed electronically to borrower's preferred participating lending institution.
Step 6: Bank evaluates loan proposal, approves credit facility up to ₹2 Crore with 3% annual interest subvention.
Step 7: CGTMSE credit guarantee fee paid by Government of India; loan disbursed in milestone tranches.
application_process_md:
### How to Apply for Agriculture Infrastructure Fund (AIF)

1. **Register on AIF Portal:** Visit [Agri Infra Portal](https://agriinfra.dac.gov.in).
2. **DPR Submission:** Submit post-harvest management infrastructure proposal.
3. **Interest Subvention:** Receive 3% per annum interest subvention up to ₹2 Crore loan.

nodal_ministry: Ministry of Commerce and Industry
implementing_agency: Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT)
summary: Financial assistance to early-stage DPIIT-recognized startups for proof of concept, prototype development, product trials, market entry, and commercialization through approved incubators.
eligibility_criteria_text: Startup recognized by DPIIT, incorporated not more than 2 years ago at the time of application.
Startup must have a business idea to develop a product or service with a market fit, viable commercialization, and scope of scaling.
Startup should be using technology in its core product or service, or business model.
Startup should not have received more than ₹10 Lakh of monetary support under any other Central or State Government scheme (excluding prize money/competitions).
Shareholding by Indian promoters in the startup should be at least 51%.

benefits.quantum_description: Up to ₹20 Lakh grant for Proof of Concept (PoC) / Prototype development / Product trials; Up to ₹50 Lakh through convertible debentures or debt-linked instruments for market entry, commercialization, and scaling.

required_documents: CA Certified Shareholding Pattern proving ≥ 51% Indian promoter holding
application_mode: Online via Startup India Portal
application_process: Step 1: Incorporate company as Private Limited or LLP and obtain DPIIT Startup Recognition Certificate on startupindia.gov.in.
Step 2: Log in to the official SISFS portal (seedfund.startupindia.gov.in) using Startup India credentials.
Step 3: Complete startup profile: innovative business model, proof of concept, commercialization potential, and fund requirement.
Step 4: Select up to 3 DPIIT-approved incubators as preferred evaluation partners based on domain/geography.
Step 5: Submit pitch deck, prototype demo video/links, and milestone execution roadmap.
Step 6: Incubator Seed Management Committee (ISMC) reviews pitch, conducts presentation/interview round.
Step 7: Upon selection: Grants up to ₹20 Lakh disbursed in milestone-based tranches for PoC / prototype; Debt/convertible debentures up to ₹50 Lakh disbursed for commercialization.
application_process_md:
### How to Apply for Startup India Seed Fund Scheme (SISFS)

1. **Prerequisite:** DPIIT Startup Recognition on [Startup India](https://www.startupindia.gov.in).
2. **Incubator Selection:** Apply on [SISFS Portal](https://seedfund.startupindia.gov.in) choosing up to 3 incubators.
3. **Evaluation & Grant:** Pitch before ISMC; receive up to ₹20 Lakhs grant or ₹50 Lakhs debt.

nodal_ministry: Ministry of Commerce and Industry
summary: ₹10,000 Crore corpus managed by SIDBI contributing capital to SEBI-registered Alternative Investment Funds (AIFs), which invest directly in innovative DPIIT-recognized startups.
eligibility_criteria_text: Startup must be recognized by DPIIT.
Must be incorporated as a Private Limited Company.
Company age must not exceed 10 years from the date of incorporation.
Startup must demonstrate innovative business model, scalable unit economics, and technology orientation.

benefits.quantum_description: Venture equity and structured growth capital deployed via SIDBI-partnered Daughter VC Funds (Series Pre-A, Series A, Series B).

application_mode: Through SEBI-registered Alternative Investment Funds (AIFs)
application_process: Step 1: Ensure entity is DPIIT-recognized startup with innovative, scalable technology or product proposition.
Step 2: Access directory of SIDBI-supported SEBI-registered Daughter Alternative Investment Funds (AIFs) on Startup India portal.
Step 3: Prepare comprehensive investor data room: pitch deck, financial model, cap table, and legal due diligence packet.
Step 4: Submit pitch proposal directly to partner AIF investment committees matching the startup sector/stage.
Step 5: Undergo venture capital evaluation, partner meetings, and formal term sheet negotiation.
Step 6: Due diligence completion and execution of Shareholders Agreement (SHA) / Share Subscription Agreement (SSA).
Step 7: Equity/quasi-equity capital drawn down from SIDBI FFS commitment directly into startup bank account.
application_process_md:
### How to Access Fund of Funds for Startups (FFS)

1. **DPIIT Recognition:** Must be recognized by DPIIT.
2. **AIF Outreach:** Approach SIDBI-backed VC funds listed on [Startup India](https://www.startupindia.gov.in).
3. **Equity Investment:** Secure venture funding through daughter AIF funds.

nodal_ministry: Ministry of Commerce and Industry / Ministry of Finance
implementing_agency: DPIIT / Inter-Ministerial Board (IMB) / Central Board of Direct Taxes (CBDT)
summary: 100% income tax deduction on profits and gains for 3 consecutive financial years out of the first 10 years since incorporation for eligible innovative startups.
eligibility_criteria_text: Incorporated as a Private Limited Company or LLP between April 1, 2016 and March 31, 2025 (or as extended in Finance Act).
Total turnover should not exceed ₹100 Crore in any of the previous financial years.
Entity must be certified by the Inter-Ministerial Board (IMB) of Certification as an innovative business working towards innovation, development or improvement of products or processes.
Company should not be formed by splitting up or reconstruction of an existing business.

benefits.quantum_description: 100% tax holiday on corporate income profits for any 3 consecutive assessment years chosen by the startup within its first 10 years.

required_documents: Memorandum of Association (MoA) and Articles of Association (AoA)
Audited Balance Sheets, P&L statements, and ITR for the last 3 financial years (or since incorporation)
Pitch deck and product video demonstrating innovation, IP, and high commercial potential
application_mode: Online via Startup India / National Single Window System (NSWS)
application_process: Step 1: Verify prerequisite: Startup must be Private Limited or LLP incorporated after April 1, 2016, with DPIIT recognition.
Step 2: Log in to Startup India Portal and navigate to Section 80-IAC Application Form.
Step 3: Upload audited financial statements, ITR returns for preceding financial years, and Memorandum/Articles of Association.
Step 4: Provide detailed business deck showcasing innovation, scalable potential for employment generation, and technological differentiation.
Step 5: Provide link to product video demonstration / live patent certificates (if filed).
Step 6: Submit application to Inter-Ministerial Board (IMB) of Certification.
Step 7: IMB evaluates application and issues Section 80-IAC Tax Exemption Certificate, granting 100% tax holiday on profits for 3 consecutive years out of 10.
application_process_md:
### How to Apply for Section 80-IAC Tax Exemption

1. **Online Form:** Apply via [Startup India Tax Exemption Portal](https://www.startupindia.gov.in/content/sih/en/tax-exemptions.html).
2. **Inter-Ministerial Board:** Submit video pitch, financial statements, and patent proofs.
3. **3-Year Tax Holiday:** Receive IMB certificate for 100% income tax deduction.

nodal_ministry: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology
summary: Scheme for Accelerating Startups for Scale-up through Mentorship, Funding, and Market Access, matching accelerator investments up to ₹40 Lakh per software tech startup.
eligibility_criteria_text: Software product startup with a demonstrable proof of concept, commercial traction, and customer validations.
Must be DPIIT recognized and registered in India.
Selected through a partner accelerator empanelled under MeitY SAMRIDH.
Indian promoter holding must be greater than 51%.

benefits.quantum_description: Matched funding up to ₹40 Lakh per startup along with 6-month customized accelerator cohort, corporate pilot linkages, and global investor demo day.

required_documents: Product metrics and active customer traction report
Cap table and valuation agreement from partnering accelerator
application_mode: Online via MeitY Startup Hub (MSH) Portal
application_process: Step 1: Startup registers on MeitY Startup Hub portal (msh.meity.gov.in).
Step 2: Verify eligibility: software product startup with established PoC/early revenue, DPIIT recognition, and Indian-majority shareholding.
Step 3: Track and apply to active open cohort calls announced by MeitY SAMRIDH-partnered accelerators.
Step 4: Submit comprehensive application detailing software product metrics, traction, customer base, and growth projections.
Step 5: Participate in accelerator screening rounds, technical demo evaluation, and pitch day before investment panel.
Step 6: Cohort admission: Receive up to ₹40 Lakh matched funding from MeitY alongside equal or higher private co-investment from accelerator/angels.
Step 7: Join 6-month customized acceleration program for scaling, enterprise customer pilots, and global market expansion.
application_process_md:
### How to Apply for MeitY SAMRIDH Accelerator

1. **MSH Portal:** Register on [MeitY Startup Hub](https://msh.meity.gov.in).
2. **Cohort Calls:** Apply to partnered accelerator programs.
3. **Matching Grant:** Secure up to ₹40 Lakhs matched government funding.

scheme_name: TIDE 2.0 Scheme (Technology Incubation and Development of Entrepreneurs)
nodal_ministry: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology
summary: Supports ICT and emerging technology startups (IoT, AI, Blockchain, Robotics) through 51 specialized incubation centers with Entrepreneur-in-Residence (EiR) and prototype grants.
eligibility_criteria_text: Aspiring tech entrepreneurs or early-stage startups working on emerging technology solutions (AI, IoT, Blockchain, CleanTech).
Applicant must be incubated or willing to incubate at a recognized TIDE 2.0 incubation center.
Focus on solving societal challenges in healthcare, education, agriculture, or financial inclusion.

benefits.quantum_description: Grant support: Up to ₹7 Lakh for Entrepreneur-in-Residence (EiR) fellows, and up to ₹40 Lakh Grant/Equity for Proof of Concept & commercialization.

required_documents: Entity registration (if incorporated) or identity proofs
application_mode: Online through designated TIDE 2.0 Incubation Centres
application_process: Step 1: Ideator / early-stage entrepreneur identifies nearby MeitY TIDE 2.0 Incubation Centre (Tier 1, 2, or 3 academic incubator).
Step 2: Select assistance track: Entrepreneur-in-Residence (EiR) for ideation or Grant-in-Aid for prototype development in ICT, IoT, AI, or electronics.
Step 3: Submit project proposal detailing ICT innovation, societal impact, and technology development milestones.
Step 4: Pitch before Incubator Selection Committee.
Step 5: Receive EiR fellowship (up to ₹30,000/month for 12 months) or Grant-in-Aid (up to ₹7 Lakh for prototype development).
Step 6: Access maker labs, mentoring, and physical incubation space at host academic institution.
application_process_md:
### How to Apply for TIDE 2.0 Scheme

1. **Incubator Center:** Connect with host TIDE 2.0 center via [MeitY MSH](https://msh.meity.gov.in/schemes/tide-2-0).
2. **EiR / Grant Track:** Apply for monthly fellowship or prototype grant up to ₹7 Lakh.
3. **Incubation:** Receive laboratory access and technical mentorship.

nodal_ministry: Ministry of Science & Technology - Department of Biotechnology
summary: Flagship early-stage grant-in-aid of up to ₹50 Lakh for biotech, medtech, diagnostics, agri-biotech, and industrial biotechnology innovations.
eligibility_criteria_text: Biotech startup incorporated for not more than 5 years, or an individual innovator with verified institutional backing.
Majority shareholding (> 51%) held by Indian citizens who are researchers, scientists, or medical entrepreneurs.
Startups must possess an incubator affiliation or independent laboratory access.
Clear scientific hypothesis and novel intellectual property path.

benefits.quantum_description: Grant-in-aid up to ₹50 Lakh for milestone-based research and proof-of-concept validation over 18 months, with zero equity dilution.

required_documents: Detailed Scientific Research Proposal with experimental milestones
Laboratory affiliation / Letter of Support from BIRAC-partner incubator
application_mode: Online via BIRAC Portal during biannual call for proposals
application_process: Step 1: Register on BIRAC portal (birac.nic.in) during the active call window (typically opens January 1 and July 1).
Step 2: Confirm eligibility: Individual biotech innovators or DPIIT-recognized startups incorporated <= 5 years with >= 51% Indian ownership.
Step 3: Select a designated BIG Partner (e.g. C-CAMP, IKP Knowledge Park, Venture Center, KIIT-TBI, FITT, BITS Pilani).
Step 4: Complete comprehensive technical proposal: unmet medical/industrial need, novelty, preliminary data, and 18-month milestone plan.
Step 5: Online technical evaluation by subject matter experts.
Step 6: Shortlisted candidates present before Technical Expert Committee (TEC) in-person or online.
Step 7: Award of up to ₹50 Lakh as 100% grant-in-aid disbursed in 4-5 milestone-linked tranches.
application_process_md:
### How to Apply for BIRAC BIG Grant (up to ₹50 Lakh)

1. **BIRAC Call Window:** Submit proposal during open call on [BIRAC Portal](https://birac.nic.in).
2. **BIG Partner Selection:** Select mentor incubator (e.g. C-CAMP, Venture Center).
3. **Grant Disbursement:** Receive up to ₹50 Lakhs 100% non-dilutive funding in milestones.

scheme_name: Atal Innovation Mission - Seed & Incubation Support
nodal_ministry: NITI Aayog
summary: Catalyzes world-class startups through Atal Incubation Centres (AICs) with prototyping labs, maker spaces, and access to seed grants.
eligibility_criteria_text: Innovators and early-stage ventures working on technology, circular economy, rural development, or high-impact social solutions.
Must apply to and be shortlisted by an Atal Incubation Centre (AIC) or Established Incubation Centre (EIC).
Clear intent to incorporate a commercial enterprise in India.

benefits.quantum_description: Incubation access, state-of-the-art laboratory infrastructure, corporate POCs, and micro seed grants ranging from ₹5 Lakh to ₹25 Lakh.

application_mode: Online via AIM NITI Aayog Portal / Atal Incubation Centres
application_process: Step 1: Innovator or startup identifies designated Atal Incubation Centre (AIC) or Established Incubation Centre (EIC).
Step 2: Submit startup application online via AIC incubator cohort application portal.
Step 3: Detail problem statement, technological innovation, IP status, and team credentials.
Step 4: Undergo evaluation by Incubator Screening Panel and present pitch deck.
Step 5: Admission to AIC: Gain physical lab access, fabrication facilities, high-performance computing, and regulatory compliance mentorship.
Step 6: Apply for internal seed grants and investor demo day matchmaking facilitated by NITI Aayog.
application_process_md:
### How to Apply for Atal Innovation Mission Support

1. **AIC Directory:** Select incubator from [Atal Innovation Mission](https://aim.gov.in).
2. **Incubator Cohort:** Submit startup application for incubation and prototyping grants.

nodal_ministry: Ministry of Science and Technology - Department of Science & Technology
implementing_agency: National Science & Technology Entrepreneurship Development Board (NSTEDB) / TBIs
summary: Debt and equity seed financing up to ₹1 Crore for technology-driven startups incubated in DST-supported Technology Business Incubators (TBIs).
eligibility_criteria_text: Registered startup incubated in a DST-approved Technology Business Incubator (TBI) for at least 3 months.
Focus on commercializing indigenous, science-backed technologies and proprietary engineering.
Indian promoter holding must be at least 51%.

benefits.quantum_description: Financial seed support between ₹25 Lakh and ₹100 Lakh per startup via equity investment, convertible debentures, or soft loan.

required_documents: Product Technical Architecture and Test Reports
application_mode: Through DST-supported Technology Business Incubators (TBIs)
application_process: Step 1: Startup must be an active resident incubatee at a DST-recognized Technology Business Incubator (TBI).
Step 2: Formulate seed support application with financial requirements up to ₹1 Crore.
Step 3: Submit application to TBI Seed Support Management Committee (SSMC).
Step 4: Committee evaluates technological innovation, commercial viability, and repayment/exit capability.
Step 5: Approval and execution of investment agreement (equity, convertible debenture, or soft loan).
Step 6: Milestone-based fund disbursement into startup escrow account.
application_process_md:
### How to Apply for NIDHI-SSS (up to ₹1 Crore)

1. **TBI Resident Incubatee:** Join a DST-recognized incubator.
2. **Seed Proposal:** Submit investment proposal to Seed Support Management Committee.
3. **Disbursement:** Seed funds released as equity or soft loan.

scheme_name: PRISM Scheme (Promoting Innovations in Individuals, Start-ups and MSMEs)
nodal_ministry: Ministry of Science and Technology - DSIR
implementing_agency: Department of Scientific and Industrial Research (DSIR)
summary: Grants up to ₹50 Lakh for individual innovators and MSMEs to translate novel, green, and industrial technical concepts into marketable working prototypes.
eligibility_criteria_text: Any individual innovator or registered micro/small enterprise with a novel technology idea.
Proposal must demonstrate novelty, techno-commercial feasibility, and potential for patent protection.
Cost of project evaluated across Phase I (Proof of Concept, max ₹5 Lakh) and Phase II (Working Prototype, max ₹50 Lakh).

benefits.quantum_description: Grant-in-aid covering up to 90% of project cost for Phase I (up to ₹5 Lakh) and up to 50% of project cost for Phase II (up to ₹50 Lakh).

required_documents: PRISM Application Form with technical description
Patent search or patent application copy
KYC and registration certificates (GST/Udyam if entity)
application_mode: Application to nearest PRISM Technology Outreach Co-ordination Centre (TOCIC)
application_process: Step 1: Download PRISM Application Form (Phase I / Phase II) from DSIR website (dsir.gov.in).
Step 2: Prepare detailed proposal on novel invention, working model, and patent search results.
Step 3: Submit proposal to nearest designated TOCIC center (hosted at premier IITs, CSIR labs, or university campuses).
Step 4: TOCIC undertakes preliminary scrutiny, interviews innovator, and assesses technical feasibility.
Step 5: Proposal forwarded to PRISM Project Advisory Committee (PAC) at DSIR headquarters.
Step 6: PAC conducts technical presentation round and sanctions grant: Up to ₹2 Lakh for Phase I PoC, ₹20 Lakh for Prototype, or ₹50 Lakh for Enterprise Incubation.
Step 7: Grant disbursed in milestone tranches with technical monitoring by assigned TOCIC coordinator.
application_process_md:
### How to Apply for DSIR PRISM Innovation Grant

1. **Proposal Formulation:** Download application forms from [DSIR PRISM](https://www.dsir.gov.in).
2. **TOCIC Screening:** Submit to local outreach center at IIT/CSIR.
3. **Grant Award:** Receive up to ₹50 Lakhs grant for product development.

nodal_ministry: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology
summary: ₹490 Crore umbrella initiative to discover, support, and scale tech startups from Tier-II and Tier-III cities across India with discovery grants and pilot linkages.
eligibility_criteria_text: DPIIT-recognized tech startups registered and operating out of Tier-II and Tier-III cities.
Tech-driven product or intellectual property.
Indian promoter ownership > 51%.

benefits.quantum_description: Financial grants up to ₹25 Lakh for pilot rollouts, cloud infrastructure credits, and direct market access partnerships.

required_documents: Registered address proof confirming Tier-II/III operational location
Product demo and customer deployment metrics
application_mode: Online via MeitY Startup Hub Portal
application_process: Step 1: Register startup profile on MeitY Startup Hub (MSH).
Step 2: Verify eligibility: Tech startup operating in Tier 2 and Tier 3 cities across emerging tech domains.
Step 3: Apply to open GENESIS calls for acceleration, seed funding, or discovery support.
Step 4: Submit pitch presentation focusing on local job creation, digital inclusion, and product roadmaps.
Step 5: Participate in virtual screening and regional jury presentation.
Step 6: Selection and grant sanction: Access seed funding, cloud infrastructure credits, and corporate partner pilots.
application_process_md:
### How to Apply for GENESIS MeitY Scheme

1. **MSH Portal:** Register on [MeitY Startup Hub GENESIS](https://msh.meity.gov.in/schemes/genesis).
2. **Tier-2/3 Startups:** Submit proposal under active challenge rounds.
3. **Incentives:** Obtain seed assistance and cloud credits.

metadata.focus_geography: Tier II and Tier III cities

nodal_ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
summary: Subsidizes comprehensive quality and environmental assessment (Zero Defect, Zero Effect) to enhance competitiveness, reduce waste, and access bank concessions.
eligibility_criteria_text: All manufacturing MSMEs registered with Udyam Registration.
Enterprise must undertake the ZED pledge and undergo digital desktop / on-site verification.
Valid GST registration required.

benefits.quantum_description: Financial subsidy on certification cost: 80% for Micro, 60% for Small, 50% for Medium enterprises. Additional 10% subsidy for women/SC/ST owned units. Up to ₹5 Lakh reward for adopting zero-pollution green technology, plus bank loan interest concessions (0.25% - 0.50%).

required_documents: Photographs of factory premises and production floor
application_mode: Online via ZED Portal
application_process: Step 1: Access official ZED Portal (zed.msme.gov.in) and click 'MSME Registration'.
Step 2: Enter valid Udyam Registration Number and mobile number to authenticate.
Step 3: Complete online 'ZED Pledge' to commit to Zero Defect Zero Effect principles and obtain instant ZED Pledge Certificate.
Step 4: Select desired Certification Level: Bronze, Silver, or Gold.
Step 5: Apply for financial subsidy on assessment fees (80% for Micro, 60% for Small, 50% for Medium + 10% for Women/SC/ST).
Step 6: Undertake desktop self-assessment or arrange on-site audit by accredited rating agencies (QCI).
Step 7: Rectify observed gaps and submit compliance proof.
Step 8: Award of official ZED Certificate, unlocking bank interest concessions, free handholding, and testing fee reimbursements.
application_process_md:
### How to Apply for MSME ZED Certification

1. **ZED Portal Login:** Authenticate using Udyam number on [ZED Portal](https://zed.msme.gov.in).
2. **Take ZED Pledge:** Get instant digital pledge certificate.
3. **Apply for Certification:** Select Bronze, Silver, or Gold with up to 90% fee subsidy.

nodal_ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
summary: Holistic ecosystem combining Incubation grants, Professional Design subsidies, and IPR reimbursements for patents, trademarks, and design registrations.
eligibility_criteria_text: Any registered MSME with Udyam Registration or student/individual innovator affiliated with an approved Host Institute (HI).
Must have an innovative concept, product design challenge, or registered patent/trademark requirement.
Commercial potential and technological viability.

benefits.quantum_description: Financial assistance: Up to ₹15 Lakh for idea incubation; Up to ₹40 Lakh for design project (MSME contribution 25%); Up to ₹5 Lakh reimbursement for Foreign Patent, ₹1 Lakh for Domestic Patent, ₹10,000 for Trademark registration.

required_documents: Detailed project report / Design brief / Patent application receipt from IPO
application_mode: Online via MSME Innovative Portal
application_process: Step 1: Log in to MSME Innovative Portal (innovative.msme.gov.in) with Udyam Registration Number.
Step 2: Select desired sub-component: Incubation (up to ₹15 Lakh for idea validation), Design (up to ₹40 Lakh for product design), or IPR (up to ₹5 Lakh for patent/trademark/GI filing).
Step 3: For Incubation: Select approved Host Institute (HI) / Business Incubator (BI) and upload project concept note.
Step 4: Host Institute Project Evaluation Committee (HIPEC) screens idea and uploads recommendation.
Step 5: National Project Monitoring and Implementation Unit (PMU) gives final sanction.
Step 6: Grant released directly to Host Institute in milestone tranches for equipment, prototyping, and raw material support.
application_process_md:
### How to Apply for MSME Innovative Scheme

1. **Single Portal:** Access [MSME Innovative](https://innovative.msme.gov.in).
2. **Choose Component:** Incubation (₹15 Lakh), Design (₹40 Lakh), or IPR (₹5 Lakh).
3. **Host Institute Review:** Idea evaluated and funded via recognized incubation centers.

scheme_name: Production Linked Incentive Scheme (PLI) for Large Scale Electronics
nodal_ministry: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology
summary: Financial incentive of 4% to 6% on incremental sales (over base year) of goods manufactured in India covering mobile phones and specified electronic components.
eligibility_criteria_text: Companies incorporated in India engaged in domestic manufacturing of target electronics products.
Must meet minimum threshold criteria of incremental cumulative investment in plant & machinery.
Must achieve minimum incremental sales threshold of manufactured goods over the base year.

benefits.quantum_description: Incentive of 4% to 6% on incremental sales (over base year) of goods manufactured in India for a period of 5 years.

required_documents: Certificate of Incorporation and Memorandum of Association
Audited Financial Statements and Statutory Auditor's certificate
Customs / Excise / GST return records proving incremental sales
Chartered Engineer certificate for plant and machinery investment
application_mode: Online via MeitY ESDM / IFCI PMA Portal
application_process: Step 1: Monitor notification of application windows by Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY).
Step 2: Prepare detailed business expansion plan: target manufacturing category, committed investment, and base year turnover.
Step 3: Submit online application on Project Management Agency (PMA - IFCI) portal with requisite non-refundable application fee.
Step 4: PMA evaluates eligibility, net worth criteria, and domestic value addition plan.
Step 5: Competent Authority / Empowered Committee issues formal approval and baseline acknowledgment letter.
Step 6: Execute committed cumulative investment thresholds over specified financial years.
Step 7: File annual incentive claims: PMA audits incremental sales of manufactured goods, and disburses 4% to 6% cash incentive on net incremental turnover.
application_process_md:
### How to Apply for Electronics PLI Scheme

1. **PMA Portal:** Submit application during notification window on [MeitY PLI](https://www.meity.gov.in/esdm/pli).
2. **Investment Milestones:** Meet baseline investment and production targets.
3. **Incentive Claims:** File annual audited claim for 4% to 6% incentive on incremental turnover.

scheme_name: Scheme for Promotion of Manufacturing of Electronic Components and Semiconductors
nodal_ministry: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology
summary: Financial incentive of 25% on capital expenditure for the manufacturing of identified electronic components, semiconductor packaging, display fabrication, and active components.
eligibility_criteria_text: Investment in new manufacturing unit or expansion of existing units for eligible electronic items.
Minimum capital expenditure investment threshold ranges from ₹5 Crore to ₹1,000 Crore depending on product category.
Application must be submitted prior to placing orders for plant and machinery.

benefits.quantum_description: 25% financial incentive on eligible capital expenditure for plant, machinery, equipment, associated utilities, and clean room facilities.

required_documents: Detailed Project Report (DPR) with technical process flow
Chartered Accountant / Engineer certificates on eligible capex
Purchase orders, bills of entry, and commissioning certificates
GST returns and plant layout approvals
application_mode: Online via MeitY ESDM Portal / IFCI PMA
application_process: Step 1: Register on MeitY ESDM online portal (meity.gov.in/esdm/specs).
Step 2: Identify eligible target goods category (passive components, semiconductors, PCB fabrication, display assembly).
Step 3: Prepare Detailed Project Report (DPR) evidencing minimum threshold investment (₹5 Crore to ₹1,000 Crore depending on product).
Step 4: Submit application online along with technical equipment lists, quotations, and financial closure plan.
Step 5: Technical evaluation by Project Management Agency (IFCI) and approval by Executive Committee.
Step 6: Receive formal approval letter specifying commencement window (up to 5 years).
Step 7: Purchase, install, and commercialize capital plant & machinery.
Step 8: File subsidy claim backed by Chartered Engineer and CA certification: Receive 25% reimbursement on eligible capital expenditure.
application_process_md:
### How to Apply for SPECS Electronics Subsidy

1. **Project Report:** Prepare capex DPR on [MeitY SPECS](https://www.meity.gov.in/esdm/specs).
2. **PMA Sanction:** Receive in-principle sanction letter from IFCI/MeitY.
3. **Capital Reimbursement:** Obtain 25% cash reimbursement on machinery procurement.

nodal_ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
summary: Subsidizes participation in national and international trade fairs, marketing exhibitions, and modern retail packaging to enhance market linkage for MSMEs.
eligibility_criteria_text: Registered manufacturing or service MSMEs holding valid Udyam Registration.
Participating in approved trade exhibitions, domestic expos, or onboarding to Government e-Marketplace (GeM).
Special priority given to women, SC/ST, and units in North Eastern Region.

benefits.quantum_description: Up to 100% stall charge reimbursement (up to ₹1.5 Lakh for domestic expos) and reimbursement of packaging and barcode certification costs.

required_documents: Stall booking receipt and participation certificate from fair organizer
application_mode: Online via MyMSME / MSME Champions Portal
application_process: Step 1: Register on MyMSME portal (my.msme.gov.in) using Udyam Registration Number.
Step 2: Select 'Procurement & Marketing Support Scheme' and choose sub-activity (Trade Fairs, Barcode Adoption, Packaging, E-Commerce onboarding).
Step 3: For Trade Fairs: Select recognized domestic or international exhibition from approved calendar and apply at least 1 month prior to event.
Step 4: MSME Development and Facilitation Office (DFO) reviews eligibility and recommends stall allotment.
Step 5: Participate in trade expo and maintain attendance/stall photographs.
Step 6: Submit reimbursement claim form within 45 days along with original stall rent receipt, travel boarding passes, and bank mandate.
Step 7: Subsidy credited via Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) into enterprise account (up to 100% stall rent reimbursement for Women/SC/ST Micro units).
application_process_md:
### How to Apply for PMS Marketing Support

1. **MyMSME Portal:** Sign up with Udyam on [Champions / MyMSME](https://champions.gov.in).
2. **Exhibition Selection:** Apply for stall booking in approved trade fairs.
3. **Reimbursement:** Submit bills to receive up to 100% reimbursement on stall rent and travel.

nodal_ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
summary: Specialized affirmative support ecosystem to empower SC/ST micro and small entrepreneurs to fulfill the 4% mandatory public procurement quota by CPSEs and ministries.
eligibility_criteria_text: Enterprise owned by SC/ST entrepreneurs (100% ownership in sole proprietorship, or at least 51% equity in partnership/company).
Valid Udyam Registration and Caste Certificate of promoter.
Applicant must be engaged in manufacturing or provision of services.

benefits.quantum_description: 100% reimbursement of Single Point Registration Scheme (SPRS) fees, 100% annual credit guarantee fee reimbursement under CGTMSE, up to ₹1 Lakh subsidy for trade fairs, and subsidized tender document fees.

required_documents: Caste Certificate issued by Competent Authority
Proof of shareholding pattern (CA certificate for companies/partnerships)
application_mode: Online via National SC-ST Hub Portal or nearest NSIC Branch
application_process: Step 1: Enterprise must have valid Udyam Registration with >= 51% shareholding by SC/ST entrepreneurs.
Step 2: Register on National SC-ST Hub portal (scsthub.in) or visit local NSIC office.
Step 3: Upload Caste Certificate, Udyam Certificate, PAN, and Bank details.
Step 4: Apply for desired interventions: Single Point Registration Scheme (SPRS) fee waiver, Special Marketing Assistance, or vendor development registration.
Step 5: Connect with Central Public Sector Enterprises (CPSEs) to participate in mandatory 4% public procurement reserved for SC/ST enterprises.
Step 6: Submit fee reimbursement claims for quality certifications (ISO/BIS/ZED) and barcode registration.
Step 7: Direct subsidy reimbursement credited into applicant bank account.
application_process_md:
### How to Apply for National SC-ST Hub (NSSH)

1. **Registration:** Enroll on [National SC-ST Hub](https://www.scsthub.in).
2. **Procurement Linkage:** Access CPSE vendor registration and tender fee waivers.
3. **Certification Reimbursement:** Get up to 100% reimbursement for quality certifications.

nodal_ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
summary: Financial assistance to MSMEs for participating in international exhibitions, trade fairs, buyer-seller meets, and technology transfer delegations abroad.
eligibility_criteria_text: Registered MSME with valid Udyam Registration and active IEC (Import Export Code).
Must have an operational track record of at least 1 year.
Participating in international fairs or business delegations approved under the IC guidelines.

benefits.quantum_description: Reimbursement of 100% economy class airfare (up to ₹1.5 Lakh) and 100% space/stall rent (up to ₹3 Lakh) for individual MSME exporters participating in foreign events.

required_documents: Passport and valid visa of travelling representative
Air tickets, boarding passes, and stall invoices
Outcome report of business meetings and export orders generated
application_mode: Online via IC Scheme Portal
application_process: Step 1: Industry association or MSME enterprise logs in to the official IC Scheme Portal (ic.msme.gov.in).
Step 2: Select relevant sub-component: Market Development Assistance (MDA) for international trade delegations, participating in international exhibitions, or organizing international conferences.
Step 3: Submit application online at least 60 days before the scheduled international event.
Step 4: Upload event brochure, organizer confirmation, participant list with Udyam numbers, and proposed budget.
Step 5: Screening Committee in Ministry of MSME reviews proposal and issues in-principle sanction.
Step 6: Participate in international exhibition/delegation abroad.
Step 7: Submit post-event claim within 90 days with airfare receipts, stall invoice, visa stamps, and event outcome report to receive financial reimbursement.
application_process_md:
### How to Apply for International Cooperation (IC) Scheme

1. **Portal Submission:** Apply on [MSME IC Portal](https://ic.msme.gov.in) 60 days before travel.
2. **Ministry Approval:** Screening committee approves MDA financial package.
3. **Claim Settlement:** Submit flight tickets and booth receipts for financial reimbursement.

nodal_ministry: Ministry of Textiles
implementing_agency: Office of Textile Commissioner / Ministry of Textiles
summary: Capital investment subsidy for the modernization and technology induction in textile segments including garmenting, technical textiles, weaving, and processing.
eligibility_criteria_text: Entity engaged in textile manufacturing intending to install benchmarked state-of-the-art machinery.
Must obtain Unique Identification Number (UID) from i-TUFS portal prior to machinery acquisition.
Term loan availed from notified lending banks/financial institutions.

benefits.quantum_description: Capital Investment Subsidy (CIS) of 10% to 15% on eligible benchmarked machinery with a subsidy ceiling up to ₹30 Crore depending on textile sub-segment.

required_documents: Bank sanction letter and appraisal note
Commercial invoices and customs clearance for imported textile machines
application_mode: Online via i-TUFS Portal (Office of the Textile Commissioner)
application_process: Step 1: Textile manufacturing entity registers on i-TUFS portal (itufs.gov.in) with Udyam and PAN.
Step 2: Apply for term loan through an empaneled lending agency (Scheduled Commercial Bank).
Step 3: Lending agency sanctions loan and uploads term loan details on i-TUFS portal.
Step 4: System generates Unique Identification Number (UID) for each machine to be procured.
Step 5: Procure eligible benchmarked machinery from approved machinery manufacturers.
Step 6: Physical joint inspection conducted by Office of Textile Commissioner and lending bank.
Step 7: Capital Investment Subsidy (10% to 15% capped at ₹20-30 Crore depending on garmenting/technical textile sector) released directly into borrower loan escrow account.
application_process_md:
### How to Apply for ATUFS Textile Subsidy

1. **i-TUFS Portal:** Register on [i-TUFS](https://itufs.gov.in).
2. **UID Generation:** Generate UID prior to machinery procurement.
3. **Joint Inspection & Subsidy:** Receive 10% to 15% capital subsidy following physical verification.

scheme_name: ASPIRE (Scheme for Promotion of Innovation, Rural Industry & Entrepreneurship)
nodal_ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
summary: Sets up Livelihood Business Incubators (LBIs) and Technology Business Incubators (TBIs) to promote rural agro-business enterprise creation and employment.
eligibility_criteria_text: Agro-rural entrepreneurs, educational institutions, or technical bodies setting up LBI/TBI incubators in rural/semi-urban areas.
Focus on skilling youth and translating rural produce into value-added enterprise goods.

benefits.quantum_description: One-time 100% grant of up to ₹1 Crore for government agencies and up to ₹50 Lakh for private bodies for plant and machinery procurement for LBI incubators.

required_documents: Curriculum and machinery layout for livelihood training
Udyam registration for participating rural units
application_mode: Online via ASPIRE MSME Portal
application_process: Step 1: Eligible implementing agency (government institute, university, R&D lab, or industry association) visits ASPIRE portal (aspire.msme.gov.in).
Step 2: Select component: Setting up Livelihood Business Incubator (LBI) or Technology Business Incubator (TBI) in agro-rural sector.
Step 3: Prepare Detailed Project Report (DPR) detailing local agro-rural raw materials, proposed training machinery, and skill incubation plans.
Step 4: Submit application online to Ministry of MSME.
Step 5: Project Screening Committee (PSC) evaluates DPR and technical viability.
Step 6: Approval by Scheme Steering Committee (SSC): 100% grant of up to ₹1 Crore for government LBIs (or ₹75 Lakh for private LBIs) for plant and machinery procurement.
Step 7: Fund disbursement in tranches for procurement, commissioning, and continuous training of rural entrepreneurs.
application_process_md:
### How to Apply for ASPIRE Rural Incubation Scheme

1. **Agro-Rural DPR:** Formulate business incubator project on [ASPIRE MSME](https://aspire.msme.gov.in).
2. **Ministry Evaluation:** Proposal reviewed by Project Screening Committee.
3. **Machinery Grant:** Receive up to ₹1 Crore grant for plant & machinery.

nodal_ministry: Industries Department, Government of Maharashtra
implementing_agency: Directorate of Industries, Maharashtra / KVIB / District Industries Centre (DIC)
summary: State flagship credit-linked subsidy scheme for youth and micro-entrepreneurs setting up manufacturing and service ventures in Maharashtra.
eligibility_criteria_text: Domicile resident of Maharashtra state aged 18 to 45 years (up to 50 years for SC/ST/Women/Ex-servicemen).
Minimum 7th standard pass for project cost up to ₹10 Lakh, and 10th standard pass for project cost above ₹10 Lakh.
Project must be located within the state of Maharashtra.
Only for new micro-enterprises in manufacturing (up to ₹50 Lakh) or service (up to ₹20 Lakh).

benefits.quantum_description: 15% to 35% capital subsidy (margin money) on project cost up to ₹50 Lakh for manufacturing and ₹20 Lakh for service units.

required_documents: Caste / Special category certificate if claiming higher subsidy
Quotation of machinery / lease agreement for factory premises
application_mode: Online via Maha-CMEGP Portal
application_process: Step 1: Visit official Maharashtra CMEGP portal (maha-cmegp.gov.in) and click 'Applicant Registration'.
Step 2: Enter Aadhaar number, name, domicile of Maharashtra, and date of birth (18-45 years, or up to 50 for SC/ST/Women).
Step 3: Fill project details: Manufacturing (cost up to ₹50 Lakh) or Service/Agro-processing (cost up to ₹20 Lakh).
Step 4: Upload educational certificate (minimum Class 7th or 10th depending on cost), domicile certificate, caste certificate (if applicable), and Project Report.
Step 5: Select Sponsoring Agency: District Industries Centre (DIC) or Maharashtra State Khadi and Village Industries Board (KVIB).
Step 6: Select preferred financing bank branch within Maharashtra.
Step 7: District Level Task Force Committee (DLTFC) chaired by District Collector screens application and conducts interview.
Step 8: Recommended application forwarded to bank; bank sanctions composite credit.
Step 9: Complete 2-week mandatory EDP training; Government of Maharashtra disburses 15% to 35% margin money subsidy directly into bank account with 3-year lock-in.

### How to Apply for Maharashtra CMEGP Scheme

1. **Maha-CMEGP Registration:** Register on [Maha CMEGP](https://maha-cmegp.gov.in).
2. **Upload Documents:** Attach domicile proof, Class 7th/10th marksheet, and project cost report.
3. **DLTFC Interview:** District Collector committee interview and recommendation to bank.
4. **Subsidy:** 15% to 35% margin money subsidy deposited in escrow.
